simple.meaning: עִלִּי (ʻillîy) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “high ; i.e. comparative.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.full: H5942. illi [ עִלּי ] adjective upper ; — feminine singular עִלִּית Judg 1:15 ; plural עִלִיּוֺת Josh 15:19 (opposed to תַּחְתִיּוֺת תַּחְתִּית, ).

occurrences.englishText: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.”
She said to him, “Give me a blessing; because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” Then Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
